hook: STASIS smart glasses read eye movements
hookText: STASIS smart glasses read eye movements

beats.say: YC-backed STASIS opened pre-orders for glasses that track 100,000+ daily eye movements with six sensors in an 11 mm frame and no outward cameras, to flag peak focus, eye fatigue and when late-night scrolling starts costing sleep.
The company claims 92% accuracy and has NBA player Moses Moody as a tester.
The launch post drew 1,800 likes and 3.1M views; this follow-up about the origin story drew 170+ likes.
